confidence_states.Existing: Preserved from a working flow mapping (requires 04-existing-flow evidence).
confidence_states.Confirmed: Supported by authoritative structural or distinctive dummy-test evidence.
confidence_states.Probable: Strongly suggested but unproved; requires human resolution; NEVER executable.

_meta.executability_rule: executable == true requires forms side AND SharePoint side each Existing or Confirmed. Enforced by scripts/validate_spec.py and scripts/generate_artifacts.py.
